evidence.title: GitHub - TanStack/query: Powerful asynchronous state management, server-state utilities and data fetching for the web.

name: TanStack Query
summary: Async state library that fetches, caches, syncs and updates server state for React, Vue, Svelte and Solid apps.
description: TanStack Query gives async data a cache with a lifecycle and declarative APIs for fetching, sharing, refetching, mutating and observing server state. Caching, request deduplication, retries, background refetching, window-focus updates and garbage collection are wired in, along with optimistic mutations and invalidation. It is protocol-agnostic (REST, GraphQL, promises) and ships adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular and Lit.
contains: 2.7B total downloads, 88M weekly downloads, 50k+ GitHub stars
cache lifecycle: stale-while-revalidate, background refetch, garbage collection
request deduplication, retries and window-focus refetching
mutations with optimistic updates, invalidation and rollback
adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular and Lit
docs with a full llms.txt for agents
